name: Kitsuji Sueharu
source:
A merchant of enormous wealth, also known as Kaneuri Kichiji.

He is good at wooing women and is apparently affable, but his way of life is somewhat ephemeral. He is feared amongst his peers as a man who will stop at nothing to do business. His ambition is to fight on with gold, not swords.......?

Organization: Rebellion (as a collaborator)
Interests: Seducing women, making money

[From the website character profile.]
